title: Melchizedek, or the Secret Doctrine of the Bible
author: J. C. F. Grumbine
description: J. C. F. Grumbine interprets the figure of Melchizedek and biblical teaching through an esoteric lens. The work approaches scripture as a source of inner spiritual meaning alongside its familiar religious narratives.
